name: apphandoff-plugin
description: AppHandoff for Claude Code: the plugin that wakes a chat when its tickets move and lists its milestones.

plugins.name: apphandoff
plugins.description: AppHandoff for Claude Code: wakes a chat when someone posts on a ticket it claimed or created or decides a milestone approval it asked for, or when a person accepts or drops a milestone it worked on, and lists the milestones it touched in one Milestones pane, with every approval waiting on you from any chat.
